```python
import DREAM.Settings.Equilibrium as Equilibrium
import DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid as RadialGrid
import DREAM.Settings.Equations as Equations
import DREAM.Settings.Transport as Transport
import DREAM.Settings.Solver as Solver
import DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper as TimeStepper
import DREAM.Settings.EquationSystem as EquationSystem
import DREAM.Settings as ds
import numpy as np

# Create DREAM settings object
ds = ds.DREAMSettings()

# Set up radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setNr(5)
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.22)
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(0.23)

# Set up equilibrium (circular, constant B)
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(2.0)  # [V/m]
ds.eqsys.n_cold.setInitialProfile(5e19)  # [m^-3]
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(20)    # [eV]

# Set up momentum grid for both hot-tail and runaway grids
pmin = 1e-3
pmax = 2.0
np_p = 150
nxi = 30
ds.hottailgrid.setNxi(nxi)
ds.hottailgrid.setNp(np_p)
ds.hottailgrid.setPmin(pmin)
ds.hottailgrid.setPmax(pmax)

ds.runawaygrid.setNxi(nxi)
ds.runawaygrid.setNp(np_p)
ds.runawaygrid.setPmin(pmin)
ds.runawaygrid.setPmax(pmax)

# Set up initial hot electron Maxwellian
ds.eqsys.f_hot.setInitialProfiles(
    type=ds.eqsys.f_hot.INITIAL_MAXWELLIAN
)

# Enable Dreicer and avalanche generation
ds.eqsys.n_re.setDreicer(True)
ds.eqsys.n_re.setAvalanche(True)

# Disable the runaway grid (use only fluid runaway electron model)
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# Set Svensson transport coefficients
ds.transport.setSvenssonDiffusion(1.0)
ds.transport.setSvenssonAdvection(0.0)

# Use nonlinear solver
ds.solver.setType(Solver.Solver.NONLINEAR)
ds.solver.setMaxIterations(100)

# Set time stepper
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(20)

# Save settings to HDF5 file
ds.save('dream_combined_fluid_kinetic_settings.h5')
```
